description: This file defines the RandomPlacementDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface to determine placement of silos in Orleans runtime, specifically selecting a random compatible silo for activation.

classes.name: RandomPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements a placement strategy that randomly selects a compatible silo for activation.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the target silo for activation, either using a placement hint if provided or selecting randomly from compatible silos.
